lines.text: After two days, Jesus left for Galilee, and the Galileans welcomed Him when He arrived.
In Cana, where Jesus had turned water into wine, a royal official begged Him to heal his dying son.
Jesus said, "Your son will live," and the official took Him at His word and departed.
On the way, his servants met him and said the fever left his son yesterday at the third hour.
The father realized it was Jesus' hour, so he and all his neighbors believed, the second sign Jesus performed.
